name: Qingwu yu Qihao Huanzhe Yuehui
source:
You wake up in a psychiatric hospital. By day, a nurse gives you a red pill and says the abnormalities you see are hallucinations. By night, “Patient No. 7” appears with the same face and asks you on a secret date. When nothing can be trusted, what can you still believe?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5220410]Steam[/url]]
